annotations.title: List the bills of a session

description: The bills of a session (the newest when `session` is omitted), in number order, 25 a page: `id, title, status, URL`. Filter by `kind` (hb House bill, sb Senate bill, hr House resolution, sr Senate resolution), `chamber` (H or S), `status` code (1 Introduced, 2 Engrossed, 3 Enrolled, 4 Passed, 5 Vetoed, 6 Failed), a caption `subject` (a headings search), or words `q`.

chamber.description: Chamber of origin: H (House) or S (Senate).
chamber.title: Chamber

kind.description: Kind of measure: hb (House bill), sb (Senate bill), hr (House resolution), or sr (Senate resolution).
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: How many entries per page, 1 to 40 (default 25).
limit.title: Limit

q.description: Words every listed bill must contain.
q.title: Q

session.description: The session, named by its years or slug: 2025-2026 (the regular session) or 2026-special. Omit for the default the tool describes.
session.title: Session

start.description: How many entries to skip, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the first page.
start.title: Start

status.description: Status code: 1 Introduced, 2 Engrossed, 3 Enrolled, 4 Passed, 5 Vetoed, 6 Failed.
status.title: Status

subject.description: A caption subject, such as Education or Income tax: a search of titles, topic tags, and subjects.
subject.title: Subject

name: bills_list
title: List the bills of a session
